study_question: Does a mandatory trivial learner (multinomial logistic / Elastic Net) trained walk-forward on production engineered features from snapshots_1m_normalized predict production ternary outcome_{hz} labels out of sample beyond always_flat / majority / persistence and chance (shuffle control), on SPY/QQQ/IWM x {1c,5c,15c,60c}?

explicitly_not.not_an_admission_packet: PASS is not decision-path admission. Admission still requires economic study + costs + operator admission.
explicitly_not.not_stack_enlargement: This is a baseline challenger. It does not join the live stack unless later admitted.

data.features: snapshots_1m_normalized via ml_train.load_data + ml_train.engineer_features(fit_end=train_end) — train-only fit for medians/category maps
data.labels: outcome_{1c,5c,15c,60c} production ternary (BAR_ANCHOR_V1) on the same rows
data.row_gates: RTH + weekday filters from load_data; label IS NOT NULL per horizon; training anchors SPY/QQQ/IWM only
data.synthetic_bar_disclosure: Labels may depend on synthetic_interior_grid_repair_v1 bars inserted in FP-01; report n_labels_touching_synthetic_bars when detectable

model.name: sklearn.linear_model.LogisticRegression
model.multiclass_note: sklearn>=1.5: multinomial path is implicit for saga+elasticnet multiclass; no multi_class kw
model.preprocessing: StandardScaler fit on train fold only, applied to test (saga numerical requirement)
model.no_hyperparameter_search: C and l1_ratio frozen; changing after seeing results invalidates the run

walk_forward.splitter: training_cache.expanding_window_oof_folds (n_folds=3) — concatenate OOS folds; single terminal holdout is insufficient for sample floors
walk_forward.honesty: embargo = longest label span (60c); not a full nested purged CV — Stage-2-grade nested purge remains a known limit named in the report

primary_metric.name: MCC (multiclass Matthews correlation, Gorodkin)
advancement_screen_per_cell: day-block bootstrap 95% CI of MCC excludes 0 (B=1000)
Holm-Bonferroni adjusted bootstrap p < 0.05 across 12 cells
accuracy >= always_flat AND majority_class AND persistence

baselines.majority_class: predict train-fold majority (for OOS rows use expanding train majority — never test-fold majority)
baselines.persistence: previous row truth (look-ahead-advantaged hard bar — same honesty note as Study #1)
